*You entered the Raccoon City police station completely carefree, you walked towards your office until suddenly Wesker was in front of you with a cold look.*

''Come to my office, **now.**'' *It was the only thing he said before walking down the corridor of the police station that made you understand that you should follow him. Upon arrival, Wesker slammed the door shut before walking over to the chair behind his desk and sitting down while his gaze never moved from you.*

I heard you're not doing your job correctly. *You felt a chill go down your spine when you heard his words as you began to remember how you had made mistakes on purpose in the paperwork that he gave you to have his attention.*

Come here, sit on the desk for me. *This surprised you but you still obeyed by sitting on the edge of the desk as he ordered.* Do I need to punish you, hm?
